findings.title: Ensure IAM policies that allow full "*-*" administrative privileges are not created
findings.description: IAM policy contains wildcard Action: '*' on Resource: '*', granting full administrative privileges.
findings.remediation: Scope actions to specific service APIs and define explicit resource ARNs with condition constraints.

findings.title: Ensure IAM policies does not allow credentials exposure
findings.description: Ensure IAM policies does not allow credentials exposure
findings.remediation: Review iam.tf and configure secure attributes according to benchmark guidelines: https://docs.prismacloud.io/en/enterprise-edition/policy-reference/aws-policies/aws-iam-policies/bc-aws-287

findings.title: Ensure IAM policy documents do not allow wildcard administrator access
findings.description: Custom AST scanner detected wildcard AdministratorAccess pattern in IAM policy.
findings.remediation: Eliminate wildcard '*' actions from IAM policy statements.

findings.title: Ensure all data stored in the RDS is securely encrypted at rest
findings.description: RDS database instance is allocated with publicly_accessible = true, assigning a public IP address accessible from the internet.
findings.remediation: Deploy RDS within private aws_db_subnet_group across multiple private subnets with publicly_accessible = false.
findings.code_snippet:
resource "aws_db_instance" "vulnerable_postgres" {
  identifier        = "app-db-vulnerable"
  allocated_storage = 20
  engine            = "postgres"
  engine_version    = "15.3"
  instance_class    = "db.t3.micro"

  # Flawed: Plaintext credentials stored directly in version control
  username = "dbadmin"
  password = "SuperSecretPassword123!"

  # Flawed: Publicly accessible
  publicly_accessible = true

  # Flawed: Encryption at rest disabled
  storage_encrypted = false

  # Flawed: No automated backups retained
  backup_retention_period = 0

  # Flawed: Automated minor version upgrades disabled
  auto_minor_version_upgrade = false

  # Flawed: No deletion protection
  deletion_protection = false

  skip_final_snapshot = true

  tags = {
    Environment = var.environment
  }
}

findings.title: Ensure all data stored in RDS is not publicly accessible
findings.description: RDS storage is unencrypted at rest, risking plaintext data exposure in disk snapshots.
findings.remediation: Enable storage_encrypted = true with a Customer Managed KMS Key (CMK).

findings.title: Ensure RDS backup retention period is configured for at least 7 days
findings.description: Enterprise disaster recovery SLA requires minimum 7-day automated backup retention.
findings.remediation: Set backup_retention_period to at least 7 days (recommended 14 days) on aws_db_instance.
findings.guideline: All RDS instances must retain automated backups for at least 7 days to satisfy business continuity SLAs.

findings.title: S3 Bucket has an ACL defined which allows public READ access.
findings.description: The S3 bucket ACL is configured as 'public-read', exposing bucket objects to anonymous internet access.
findings.remediation: Remove public-read ACL and configure aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block with all four restrictions enabled.

findings.title: Ensure that S3 buckets are encrypted with KMS by default
findings.description: S3 Bucket is not encrypted with Customer Managed Key (CMK).
findings.remediation: Configure aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration with KMS key (aws:kms).

findings.title: Ensure S3 server side encryption uses Customer Managed Key (CMK) ARN
findings.description: Ensure S3 server side encryption uses Customer Managed Key (CMK) ARN
findings.remediation: Review s3.tf and configure secure attributes according to benchmark guidelines: None

findings.title: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 22
findings.description: Security group opens port 22 (SSH) to the entire public Internet (0.0.0.0/0), exposing virtual instances to brute-force attacks.
findings.remediation: Restrict SSH ingress to specific bastion host CIDRs or use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager with no open ports.

findings.title: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 3389
findings.description: Security group allows unrestricted ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 3389 (RDP).
findings.remediation: Restrict RDP ingress (port 3389) to specific trusted CIDRs or VPN gateways.
